objective: Implement the first local database foundation for the mobile app, including schema, incremental migrations, and repository-layer support for the core record types.
success_criteria: The mobile app has a local database foundation under mobile/field_work_agent/lib/data/database.
A schema version table exists in the database foundation.
Migrations are structured for incremental execution instead of one-shot schema creation.
Repository-layer support exists for projects, tasks, meetings, raw captures, and audit logs.
The work preserves local-only storage and does not introduce sync or hosted-backend assumptions.
stop_conditions: The task requires selecting or changing a persistence package strategy that is not already implied by the app package setup.
The task cannot be completed without editing paths outside the allowed scope.
The implementation would require introducing sync, shared backend, or cross-device storage behavior.
The task needs a new verification command that is not yet part of the repo harness.
approval_gates: Adding or replacing major persistence dependencies
Expanding scope beyond T1 database foundation
Changing canonical product or architecture docs instead of implementing within the allowed code paths
deliverables: Tests or validation hooks that fit the current harness
notes: Ticket source: docs/implementation-tickets.md T1 Create local database foundation.
Meeting and task separation must remain intact even at the repository layer.
